$comment: Keyword primers - one-shot micro-tutorials shown the FIRST time a mechanic is sighted (docs/PRIMERS.md is the authoring guide). Text rules: ONE sentence, ~12 words max, states the RULE not flavor, sourced/compressed from keywords.data.json defs - a primer must never contradict the glossary. '$signal_hook_examples' entries are documentation only (not loaded): they show the future signal_hook trigger shape. The four targeting-personality primers (SYSTEMATIC/WOUNDED/PACK/SPITEFUL) were CUT 2026-07-10 (Kev: a regular user doesn't need attack-style tutorials) - the unit long-press popup's TARGETING line remains the reference.

primers.text: JAM: this die's next roll is capped at 10.
FREEZE: the die keeps its face - that unit acts again.
REWRITE: this die's next roll becomes 3.
HIJACK: this enemy's next roll copies your highest die.
MARK: the next hit on this unit deals +50%.
FIREWALL: blocks the next ability aimed at this unit, then breaks.
CLOAK: can't be targeted directly; breaks when it deals damage.
TAUNT: the taunted unit can only target the taunter.
BURN: takes damage at the end of each round.
SPIKE: attackers take damage back this round.
ACCRETE: gains shield at the start of each of its turns.
CHAIN: the hit also jumps to the lowest-HP other enemy.
DETONATE: consumes the burn for its remaining damage, instantly.
EXECUTE: bonus damage when the target is below 25% HP.
BREACH: destroys all shield on the target before the damage.
PIERCE: the damage ignores shields - they stay up.
LEECH: the attacker heals half the damage dealt.
SIPHON: that hit drained your Protocol.
REVIVE: a fallen unit returns to the fight.
RAMPAGE: a stored charge doubled that hit's damage.
PACK BONUS: +1 damage per other living pack member.
SUMMON: this enemy calls reinforcements into the fight.

primers.$comment: icon_first_seen entries (Bug-2, 2026-07-12): non-keyword pip icons - the icon itself is the lesson. Fired by KeywordPrimer.notice_rolled_ability via ICON_TRIGGERS; only damage/heal/shield are exempt (HIGHLIGHT_EXEMPT_ICONS).
primers.text: HITS ALL: this marker means the effect applies to every unit on that side.
TARGETS LOWEST: this effect automatically picks the lowest-HP ally.
±ROLL: this unit's die rolls are shifted by that amount for the shown turns.
TARGETS SELF: this marker means the effect applies to the unit using it.
PROTOCOL: adds to the squad's shared pool for dice actions and items.

primers.$comment: Cleanse (Kev 2026-07-21): keyword icon, roll-sighted like the icon_first_seen family (no event-stream fallback - cleanse emits no feedback event). Doubles as the tutorial's ONE showcase primer: Splice Medic's turn-2 Infusion (10 heal, cleanse) sights it naturally, so the drill demonstrates the first-encounter tip with a real primer and it stays seen.
primers.text: CLEANSE: strips burn, roll penalties, and jam - frozen dice stay frozen.
